source: WHO Water Safety in Emergencies / IFRC Cholera Response Toolkit

translations.en: Stop use of all local water sources immediately. Do not drink, cook with, or bathe in potentially contaminated water.
translations.bi: Stopem yus blong olgeta local wota naoia. No dring, no kukim witem, no betem bodi long wota we hemi posibli contaminated.
translations.tpi: Stopim yusim olgeta wara bilong ples nau. No dring, no kukim, no wasim bodi long wara i ken bagarap.
translations.ht: Sispann itilize tout sous dlo lokal imedyatman. Pa bwè, kwit, oswa benyen nan dlo ki posibleman kontamine.

translations.en: Distribute water purification tablets (1 tablet per 1L). Boil water for at least 1 minute if tablets unavailable.
translations.bi: Givim wota purification tablets (1 tablet long 1L). Boilem wota blong wan minit olsem les sapos no gat tablets.
translations.tpi: Givim wara purification tablets (1 tablet long 1L). Boilim wara bilong 1 minit o moa sapos no gat tablets.
translations.ht: Distribye tablèt pou purifye dlo (1 tablèt pou 1L). Fè bouyi dlo pou omwen 1 minit si pa gen tablèt disponib.

translations.en: Identify and isolate any persons showing symptoms: diarrhea, vomiting, fever. Report to health coordinator immediately.
translations.bi: Faenemaot mo separetem eni man we hemi sik: diarrhea, vomiting, fiva. Reportem long health coordinator naoia.
translations.tpi: Painim na separetem eni man i sik: diarrhea, tokim, fiva. Reportim long health coordinator nau.
translations.ht: Idantifye epi izole nenpòt moun ki montre sentòm: dyare, vomisman, lafyèv. Rapòte bay kòdonatè sante a imedyatman.

translations.en: Establish handwashing stations with soap or alcohol-based sanitizer at all food preparation and latrine sites.
translations.bi: Mekem handwashing stesen wetem sop oa sanitizer long olgeta ples blong kukim kakae mo toilet.
translations.tpi: Mekim ol ples bilong wasim han long sop o sanitizer long olgeta ples bilong kukim kaikai na toilet.
translations.ht: Etabli estasyon lavaj men ak savon oswa dezenfektan à base d'alkòl nan tout sit preparasyon manje ak latrinn.

translations.en: Collect a water sample in a sealed container for lab testing when health team arrives. Mark with GPS coordinates and time.
translations.bi: Kolek wota sample insaed long sealed kontena blong lab test taem health tim i kambak. Makem wetem GPS koodinet mo taem.
translations.tpi: Kisim wara sample insait long sealed kontena bilong lab test taem helth tim i kam. Makim long GPS na taim.
translations.ht: Kolekte yon echantiyon dlo nan yon konteyè sele pou tès laboratwa lè ekip sante a rive. Make ak kòdone GPS ak lè.
